correctness.rationale: Exact distance formula yields the complete MMD step sets. The established vertex-cover equivalence reduces all strong metric bases to complements of maximum independent sets. Their complete classification follows from antipodal-pair and forbidden-gap arguments in four residues; a case-complete one-exchange proof gives C_n or Q_{n/2}. The direct geodesic verifier confirms all orders 6 through 20, with all smaller cardinalities checked independently through order 15. Infinite conclusions rely on the proof.

value.rationale: For one canonical infinite circulant family, the complete optimum-set count and token-jumping geometry abruptly change from an n-cycle of bases to a hypercube with 2^{n/2} bases in exactly one residue class. This is not a relabeling or consequence of a scalar minimum size: it classifies every optimum sensor set and supplies shortest exchange routes. The sharp periodic transition is both intrinsic and reusable for testing solution-space algorithms.
